31792-XI.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (VROM), both the departmental budget and the baten-lasten budget, by adjusting appropriations in line with the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December 2008 or the day after publication if later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

31965-IV.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement for Koninkrijksrelaties (Kingdom Relations) in line with the spring budget memorandum, adjusting appropriations for the guarantee function and for supporting the autonomy of Kingdom partners. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 June 2009.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for Kingdom Relations for the year 2009 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31965-VI.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (first supplementary budget 2009, linked to the Spring Memorandum) that amends the Ministry of Justice's 2009 departmental budget statement, raising expenditure and receipts in the courts, legal aid and crime-fighting articles. The explanatory memorandum justifies the increases mainly by higher costs of civil and administrative court caseloads due to the economic crisis and changes in sentencing and supervision practice.
31965-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by expected growth in civil and administrative court cases from the economic crisis and by changes in sentencing and post-release supervision.
q: As a result of the economic crisis, the inflow of civil and administrative cases is expected to rise.
Als gevolg van de economische crisis is de verwachting dat de instroom van het aantal civiele en bestuurszaken zal stijgen.

32395-XI.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statutes of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment and the Waddenfonds, following the spring memorandum (Voorjaarsnota). It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
32395-XI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes as a means to inform the Staten-Generaal about deviations from the original budget, serving its allocation and authorisation functions.
q: The supplementary budget is intended to submit (interim) deviations from the original budget to the States General.
De suppletore begroting is bedoeld om (tussentijds) afwijkingen ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke begroting voor te leggen aan de Staten-Generaal.

32565-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement for the Dutch National Debt (IXA), altering expenditure and revenue figures following the Najaarsnota. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2010.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc. To all who shall see or hear read these presents, greetings!
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz. Allen, die deze zullen zien of horen lezen, saluut!

32609-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (Article IXB) through an incidental supplementary budget linked to the departmental reorganisation. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 2 January 2011 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The act enters into force on 2 January of the current budget year.
Wet treedt in werking met ingang van 2 januari van het onderhavige begrotingsjaar.

32710-XII.s: This bill is a Slotwet that amends the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the related baten-lastendiensten budgets for KNMI, RWS and IVW, to reflect realised figures. It contains only technical, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments and does not delegate rule-making or shift powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation adjustments, bookkeeping-type adjustments, or adjustments arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

32780-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by adjusting spending and revenue lines, including the Belastingdienst, financial markets supervision contributions and the public-private financing article. It takes effect from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Designing policy aimed at generating revenue and achieving non-fiscal objectives of government policy
Het ontwerpen van beleid gericht op het genereren van inkomsten en het realiseren van niet-fiscale doelstellingen van het overheidsbeleid

33000-VIII.s: The bill establishes the 2012 departmental budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, including expenditure and revenue ceilings per policy article and the budget of the baten-lastendienst DUO and Nationaal Archief. The explanatory memorandum excerpt describes policy goals and budget tables for primary, secondary, vocational, higher and teacher policy without delegating new rule-making powers.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2012 attached to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33090-VII.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (departmental and baten-lastendiensten) in thousands of euros, effective from 1 December 2011 with retroactive effect if published later. It is a budget adjustment (Najaarsnota) that reallocates expenditure, revenue and borrowing across article lines without new substantive powers.
q: We ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2011 is amended
Wij Beatrix ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd

34350-VII.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the related agency budget, shifting amounts across policy and non-policy articles in the second supplementary budget. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date, including retroactive effect to 1 June in certain cases.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII)

34485-IV.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) via a first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with retroactive effect to 1 June 2016. The explanatory memorandum shifts small budget amounts among articles, including a reduction of 1,700 thousand euros for the Kustwacht that is deferred to 2018.
q: The replacement investments in the Coast Guard's equipment in the Caribbean will only be paid in 2018.
De vervangingsinvesteringen in het materieel van de Kustwacht in het Caribisch gebied komen pas in 2018 tot betaling.

34485-VI.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice (first supplementary budget), adjusting spending, revenue and commitments across policy articles and agencies. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2016.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for the year 2016
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2016

34620-VII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (chapter VII) and its agency budget, with amounts in thousands of euros. It sets an effective date of 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We, Willem Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

34845-IV.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fund (H) through a second supplementary budget, changing appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December 2017 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: In view of the security situation in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, €8 million is incidentally added.
Met het oog op de veiligheidssituatie in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk wordt incidenteel € 8 mln.

34845-VI.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2017 departmental budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the agency budgets, adjusting spending, revenue and investment figures in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers budgetary effects on items such as police, legal aid, the judiciary and migration, and notes that a new C2000 communications system migration slips to 2018.
q: We Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

34960-IX.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in the first supplementary budget, adjusting tax revenue, expenditure and debt financing figures in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 June 2018 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2018.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2018.

35071-(R2110).s: The bill amends three Kingdom laws (Consular Act, Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid Act, Schepen Act) to adapt them to the Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren. It switches appointment of consular heads and harbour inspection officials from ordinary appointment to designation by royal decree or ministerial designation, and repeals a provision of the Onderzoeksraad Act.
35071-(R2110).j: The memorandum justifies the designation approach by the need to keep existing royal decrees alongside employment contracts after the Wnra takes effect, and by the unusualness of referring to a named general administrative decree in a statute.
q: Article 13 of the Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid lapses.
Artikel 13 van de Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid vervalt.
d: designation of heads of consular posts by royal decree
designation of harbour inspection officials by the Minister
p: Artikel II (Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid art. 13)
Repeals article 13 of the Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid Act, whose content is not stated in the bill, with no replacement shown.

35095-IX.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2018 departmental budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as taxes, financial markets, and debt financing. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power and only sets an effective date and amends budget tables.
q: Is amended, as appears from the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35925-IV.s: The bill formally adopts the 2022 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (Kingdom Relations) and the BES-fonds for the Caribbean Netherlands, giving them legal force in one law. The explanatory memorandum describes financial supervision, liquidity support, border control spending and a planned new Caribisch orgaan voor hervorming en ontwikkeling, but the bill itself contains no delegation or power-shifting provisions.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are each adopted separately by law under article 2.3(1) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 2.3, eerste lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 elk afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without any remarks, that the 2022 budget bill for Koninkrijksrelaties and the BES-fonds be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments and refers to annexes, while the advice is otherwise accepted.

35925-VI.s: This bill sets the 2022 budget (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Justice and Security, including its departmental budget and the budgets of the agencies DJI, CJIB, NFI, Justis, IND, Justid and JIO, and it confirms that the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the operational efficiency of the judiciary. The accompanying memorandum describes policy priorities, budgeted expenditures, evaluation agenda and related measures, but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: With reference to article 4.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Minister for Legal Protection is not responsible for the operational efficiency of the judiciary's management.

Onder verwijzing naar artikel 4.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 13 September 2021, that it had no remarks on the draft 2022 budget bill for the Ministry of Justice and Security (Vi) and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 20 September 2021 notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in attached appendices.

36600-VII.s: This bill sets the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of its executive agencies (agentschappen), in thousands of euros. It is a budget law that fixes appropriations and revenues without itself creating new delegated rule-making powers.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2025 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket opinion on the 2025 budget bill for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII), raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's reply notes that some budget changes have proved necessary and refers to annexes, without raising any objections of the Afdeling.

36625-IX.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros and making the changes effective from 1 December 2024. The explanatory memorandum lists the main budget line changes, such as reduced spending on a container scanning tender and on camera supervision, and notes that tax revenue changes are explained in the Najaarsnota.
q: In this second supplementary budget this has been corrected.
In deze tweede suppletoire begroting is dit gecorrigeerd.

36850-IX.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue by thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2025.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36915-IV.s: This bill amends the 2026 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure and commitment figures across policy and non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum describes the changes as budget transfers, efficiency cuts and reallocations for border control, criminal investigation and the judiciary, without delegating rule-making power.
36915-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as budget mutations following the coalition agreement and the need to reallocate funds, not as a grant of new executive powers.
q: The funds made available for the Caribbean undermining approach 2026 are transferred from the Kingdom Relations budget to the Justice and Security budget.
De beschikbaar gestelde middelen voor de ondermijningaanpak Cariben 2026 worden overgeheveld van de begroting van Koninkrijksrelaties naar de begroting van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI).

36915-VI.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2026 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budgets of its agencies, shifting several billion euros across police, justice, detention and counterterrorism articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement concerning the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2026

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2026
